title: Looking Out for You
lyrics:
[00:20.48]I guess I should stop looking out for you
[00:27.86]Like I always do
[00:31.41]When will you start looking out for me too
[00:36.38]Instead of leaving me staring at my shoes?
[00:40.97]Just the way you're glancing at me
[00:45.16]Something about you
[00:47.21]Just makes me feel guilty for liking you
[00:53.82]When you're with him
[00:56.15]When you're with him
[01:00.03]This is a love song for a girl
[01:02.67]Who will never know it's about her
[01:04.77]Know it's pretty stupid
[01:06.18]But I'm much too shy to tell her
[01:09.48]She's beaming that smile, all the while
[01:14.25]I'm all choked up on my own throat
[01:16.94]I guess there is no hope
[01:36.84]When you're walking out in the snow
[01:41.15]I say, "I guess I should go"
[01:46.40]And we're talking 'bout someone else
[01:51.28]When we should be talking about ourselves
[01:56.17]It's the same old situation
[01:58.64]You've always got me waiting
[02:02.03]Come on, dear, I think time's a wastin'
[02:05.90]Before we have to go back inside
[02:10.07]And return to our normal lives
[02:16.23]This is a love song for a girl
[02:18.98]Who will never know it's about her
[02:21.06]Know it's pretty stupid
[02:22.38]But I'm much too shy to tell her
[02:25.73]She's beaming that smile, all the while
[02:30.28]I'm all choked up on my own throat
[02:33.19]I guess there is no hope
